## Classes

### CairnDefinitionError

Bounded error thrown when a trusted family declaration violates Cairn's version
1 definition invariants.

This error retains no rejected definition, family, kind, cause, or detail.

### CairnGenerationError

Bounded error thrown when secure entropy is unavailable during codec generation.

This error retains only validated family and kind metadata and never exposes a
foreign cause, detail, or random bytes.

#### Extends

- `Error`

#### Constructors

## Functions

### defineIdFamily()

```ts
function defineIdFamily<F, D>(definition): IdFamily<F, D>;
```

Validates one trusted version 1 family declaration and creates its readonly
family-scoped codecs.

Family and kind names, prefixes, own-key counts, and prefix uniqueness must
satisfy the accepted Cairn invariants before any codec is returned.

#### Type Parameters

| Type Parameter                                                                            | Description                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `F` _extends_ `string`                                                                    | Literal identifier-family name.               |
| `D` _extends_ `Readonly`\<`Record`\<`string`, `Readonly`\<\{ `prefix`: `string`; \}\>\>\> | Literal own kind declarations for the family. |

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                                             | Description                                       |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `definition` | `Readonly`\<\{ `family`: `F`; `version`: `1`; `kinds`: `D`; \}\> | Trusted version 1 family declaration to validate. |

#### Returns

[`IdFamily`](#idfamily)\<`F`, `D`\>

One readonly codec property for every own kind key.

#### Throws

[CairnDefinitionError](#cairndefinitionerror) When any declaration invariant or
property access fails.
